name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Searchable select, single or multiple, with descriptions under each option.
htmlExample:
<bef-combobox emit="value-change" placeholder="Pick a city" search-placeholder="Search cities" style="width:260px" :options='[{"value":"pune","label":"Pune"},{"value":"blr","label":"Bengaluru","description":"Karnataka"},{"value":"mum","label":"Mumbai"},{"value":"del","label":"Delhi"}]'></bef-combobox>
<bef-multi-combobox emit="value-change" :value="[]" placeholder="Pick cities" style="width:260px" :options='[{"value":"pune","label":"Pune"},{"value":"blr","label":"Bengaluru"},{"value":"mum","label":"Mumbai"}]'></bef-multi-combobox>
